title: Key events by channel group
path: Reports > Life cycle > Acquisition > Traffic acquisition
steps: In the Google Merchandise Store property, open Reports > Life cycle > Acquisition > Traffic acquisition.
Set the date range to the month the app shows, from its first day to its last.
Make sure the table's first column is Session default channel group. If it shows another dimension, choose Session default channel group from the drop-down at the top of that column.
Sort the table by the Key events column, highest first, by clicking its header.
Read the channel group and the key events in the first channel row below the totals row, then the key events in the second channel row below the totals row.

parts.question: Which session default channel group has the most key events in the month?

parts.label: Top group's key events
parts.question: How many key events does that channel group have?
